title: Whisperrr
tagline: Bet on anything. Nobody knows it's you. AI risk scoring, Ledger signing
description:
Whisper is a privacy-first prediction market frontend built on top of Polymarket's real liquidity. Users deposit funds into       
  Unlink's ZK privacy pool, which generates burner wallets to place bets on live markets — making positions completely untraceable. An
   AI copilot analyzes every market using Polymarket's Gamma API (odds momentum, volume trends, expected value) and surfaces the best 
  opportunities. When signing a bet on a Ledger hardware wallet, the AI risk analysis is displayed directly on-device via Clear       
  Signing. Beyond human traders, Whisper exposes an x402-powered API that lets autonomous agents — verified through World ID 4.0 — 
  place bets programmatically. Funds are bridged from Base to Polygon via CCTP V2 in ~15 seconds, executed on Polymarket's CLOB, and
  re-shielded back through the privacy pool.
how_its_made:
Whisper connects three partner technologies into a single pipeline. Unlink provides the privacy layer: users deposit into a ZK    
  shielded pool on Base Sepolia, and Unlink generates disposable burner wallets for each session. Funds bridge to Polygon via Circle's
   CCTP V2, then route to Polymarket's CLOB API for execution. The AI copilot scores markets using heuristics on Polymarket's Gamma   
  API — real-time odds, volume, depth, and trend data to compute expected value. This analysis is pushed to Ledger's Clear Signing    
  protocol so risk breakdown renders on the hardware wallet screen during approval. For the agent API, we integrated World's Agent Kit
   with x402 micropayments: external agents pay per-request and must prove human verification via World ID 4.0 to prevent sybil-driven
   market manipulation. The frontend is a React app that abstracts the entire flow — users see markets, AI scores, and a bet button.
auto_summary: A Next.js frontend routes private prediction-market deposits, betting, AI scoring, and Ledger signing across Unlink, Polygon, and Polymarket.
